metamorphic_relations.title: Retry identity
metamorphic_relations.relation: Replacing one logical dictation cannot increase logical dictation count.

metamorphic_relations.title: Cross-day conservation
metamorphic_relations.relation: Move A→B changes both days by exactly that fact and preserves all-time totals.

metamorphic_relations.title: Content deletion independence
metamorphic_relations.relation: Removing content cannot change independent usage totals.

metamorphic_relations.title: Usage deletion independence
metamorphic_relations.relation: Removing usage cannot mutate transcript, note or reviewed evidence content.

metamorphic_relations.title: Filter narrowing
metamorphic_relations.relation: Adding a supported app/mode restriction cannot enlarge the dictation cohort; every filtered breakdown uses the same restriction.

metamorphic_relations.title: Timezone conservation
metamorphic_relations.relation: Zone changes alter local grouping, not all-time fact count or word totals.

metamorphic_relations.title: Full aggregate equivalence
metamorphic_relations.relation: Incremental state equals an independent all-field reduction and a correct rebuild from current facts.

metamorphic_relations.title: Latency observation removal
metamorphic_relations.relation: Removing one observed latency lowers that metric n by one and leaves unrelated cohorts unchanged.

metamorphic_relations.title: App-label rename
metamorphic_relations.relation: Changing display labels without changing stable app identity does not split or merge entities.

metamorphic_relations.title: Exclusive readiness partition
metamorphic_relations.relation: Moving an example to excluded removes it from live outcome/completeness/task populations and adds it only to the excluded class.

metamorphic_relations.title: Associated deletion locality
metamorphic_relations.relation: Deleting A-associated usage cannot remove B or an unrelated selection transform; stale derived copies of A do not remain.

metamorphic_relations.title: Non-dictation activity has no dictated words
metamorphic_relations.relation: Explicit transforms and repastes can change activity counts only, never logical dictation or dictated-word totals.

metamorphic_relations.title: Fact-order invariance
metamorphic_relations.relation: Permuting independent input facts preserves every final aggregate; only explicit latest-outcome ordering may matter for replacements.

metamorphic_relations.title: Measurement delay sensitivity
metamorphic_relations.relation: A delay inserted in a claimed timed operation moves that operation measurement; an excluded phase does not silently enter it.
